BusinessLocationsSettings.title: Offices
BusinessLocationsSettings.description: When a customer shares a location, scenarios find the nearest active office in this list.

empty.title: No offices yet
empty.manager: Add offices one at a time, or import a CSV or Excel file.

outliers.title: Check these pins

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivateDialog.description: Scenarios stop routing to {name} right away. You can turn it on again later.

errors.feature_disabled: Offices are turned off for this workspace. Reload the page.
errors.manager_required: Only workspace admins and managers can change offices.
errors.body_too_large: Too much data in one request. Import fewer offices at a time.
errors.invalid_request: The office data could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_offices: Some offices have invalid fields. Fix them and try again.
errors.duplicate_keys: These keys are used more than once: {keys}.
errors.office_limit: A workspace can have at most {limit} active offices. Deactivate some first.
errors.record_limit: A workspace can keep at most {limit} offices, inactive ones included.
errors.office_key_taken: An office with this key already exists. Choose another key.
errors.save_conflict: Another change was saved at the same time. Reload the page and try again.
errors.save_failed: Could not save offices. Try again.
errors.load_failed: Could not load offices. Try again.
errors.access_denied: You can no longer change offices here. Reload the page.

issues.key_invalid: Use 1 to {max} Latin letters, digits, _ or - for the key.
issues.map_url_invalid: Use a full https:// link of up to {max} characters.

issues.longitude_invalid: Longitude must be a number from -180 to 180.
issues.coordinates_zero: 0, 0 is not an office location. Check the coordinates.

dialog.description: Customers who share a location are sent to the nearest active office.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Scenarios use the key. It can't be changed later.
dialog.keyLocked: The key can't be changed. To use another key, add a new office and deactivate this one.
dialog.coordinatesHint: Paste latitude and longitude, or a full Google Maps link.
dialog.coordinatesShortLink: Open the link in a browser and copy the coordinates.
dialog.coordinatesNoPoint: This link has no coordinates. Paste the coordinates instead.
dialog.coordinatesInvalid: These coordinates can't be read. Use latitude, longitude, e.g. 43.238949, 76.889709.
dialog.mapUrlHint: Customers get this link as {token}. Without it they get a Google Maps link to the coordinates.
dialog.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
dialog.tagsHint: A scenario can take a separate route when the nearest office has a tag.
dialog.activeHint: Scenarios only route to active offices.

import.title: Import offices
import.description: Offices are matched by key. New keys are added and existing offices are updated.
import.accepted: CSV, XLSX or XLS, up to {max} offices per file.
import.columnsHint: Required columns: name, country, city, and latitude with longitude or one coordinates column. Optional: key, address, phone, map_url, tags, active, sort_order. Headers can be in English, Russian or Kazakh.
import.preview: {created} new · {updated} updated · {unchanged} unchanged · {missing} not in the file
import.deactivateMissing: Deactivate {count, plural, one {# office} other {# offices}} missing from the file
import.deactivateMissingHint: Scenarios stop routing to them right away. Leave this off to keep them active.
import.derivedKeys: {count, plural, one {# row has no key, so its key was made} other {# rows have no key, so their keys were made}} from country, city and name. Renaming an office in a later file creates a new office.
import.keptColumns: Not in the file: {columns}. Offices already in the list keep their current values for these.
import.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} to fix before importing
import.limit: After this import there would be {count} active offices, over the limit of {limit}. Deactivate the offices missing from the file or remove rows.
import.submit: Import {count, plural, one {# office} other {# offices}}
import.serverRows: Some rows were refused. Fix them in the file and choose it again.

errors.invalid_file: This file can't be read. Save it as CSV or XLSX and try again.
errors.invalid_encoding: This CSV isn’t saved as UTF-8, so its letters would come out garbled. In Excel, choose Save As → “CSV UTF-8”, or upload the XLSX file.
errors.too_many_rows: The file has more than {max} offices. Split it into smaller files.
errors.country_unknown: The country isn't recognized. Use a two-letter code such as KZ, or the country name.
errors.coordinates_missing: Add coordinates: latitude and longitude, or one coordinates cell.
errors.coordinates_short_link: Short map links can't be read. Open the link in a browser and copy the coordinates.
errors.coordinates_no_point: This link has no coordinates. Paste the coordinates instead.
errors.key_not_derivable: A key can't be made from this row's city and name. Add a key column.
errors.duplicate_key: The key {key} is on more than one row. Give each office its own key in the key column.
errors.active_invalid: The active value isn't recognized. Use true or false, yes or no.
